hero_intro: Our vision is to bring this beloved former school back to life with affordable senior apartments, community event space, and a family funhouse.
story_heading: Built for a school. Reimagined for the community.
story_p1: Behind Ronan Schoolhouse is our family, kids included. We’re taking this on with a family budget, plenty of questions, and a willingness to learn. Some days, progress means figuring out the next step.
story_p2: We don’t have every step mapped out, but we know what we want this place to become: affordable homes for older adults, space for neighbors to gather, and a funhouse for families. This school already means so much to the community. We want to give it a chance to serve that community again.
